name: Savagery
blurb: Active:  Rengar gains  bonus attack speed for his next two  basic attacks. His next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and will  critically strike, dealing increased damage based on his  critical strike chance.

effects.description: Active: Rengar gains 40% bonus attack speed on his next two basic attacks within 3 seconds.

His first attack is empowered to stab the target, having an uncancellable windup, gaining 25 bonus range, and dealing bonus physical damage. The attack can critically strike for (100% + 30%) AD bonus physical damage.
Ferocity Bonus: Savagery's damage is modified to deal 35 - 260 (based on level) (+ 20% AD) bonus physical damage. Rengar instead gains 50% - 107% (based on level) bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.
Savagery resets Rengar's basic attack timer.

notes:
Savagery deals  basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as  spell damage.
Savagery's empowered attack is consumed against jungle plants.
The bonus attack speed from the unempowered and empowered casts can stack with each other, if both are cast shortly one after another.
The enhanced attack applies other  on-hit effects as well as  life steal as normal.
Casting Savagery does not  break stealth.
